# NS Index 분석

## NS Index 계산

NS Index = VIX(40%) + Volatility(30%) + SemiDensity(20%) + Re(10%)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "NS Index 구성 요소별 기여도"

# NS Index Calculation
vix_val = 17.48
vix_score = max(0, min(100, (30 - vix_val) / 20 * 100))  # 62.6

vol_score = 55.0  # Declining from 31 to 17, but avg still elevated at 19

semi_score = 75.0  # Semis leading market significantly

re_val = 4.80
re_score = max(0, min(100, (7 - re_val) / 4 * 100))  # 55.0

# Weighted NS Index
ns_index = vix_score * 0.4 + vol_score * 0.3 + semi_score * 0.2 + re_score * 0.1
ns_components = {
    'VIX\n(40%)': vix_score * 0.4,
    'Volatility\n(30%)': vol_score * 0.3,
    'Semi Density\n(20%)': semi_score * 0.2,
    'Re (ERP)\n(10%)': re_score * 0.1
}

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))

# Pie chart
colors_pie = ['#2ecc71', '#3498db', '#9b59b6', '#e67e22']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax1.pie(
    list(ns_components.values()),
    labels=list(ns_components.keys()),
    colors=colors_pie,
    autopct='%1.1f%%',
    startangle=90,
    textprops={'fontsize': 10}
)
ax1.set_title(f'NS Index = {ns_index:.1f} / 100', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

# Score breakdown bar
components = ['VIX Score', 'Vol Score', 'Semi Score', 'Re Score', 'NS Index']
scores = [vix_score, vol_score, semi_score, re_score, ns_index]
bar_colors = ['#2ecc71', '#3498db', '#9b59b6', '#e67e22', '#e74c3c']
bars = ax2.barh(components, scores, color=bar_colors, edgecolor='white', height=0.5)
ax2.set_xlim(0, 100)
ax2.set_xlabel('Score (0-100)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_title('Component Scores', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.axvline(x=50, color='gray', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label='Neutral')

for bar, val in zip(bars, scores):
    ax2.text(bar.get_width() + 1, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
            f'{val:.1f}', va='center', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)

ax2.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print(f"\n=== NS Index Result ===")
print(f"VIX ({vix_val}) Score: {vix_score:.1f} x 0.4 = {vix_score*0.4:.1f}")
print(f"Volatility Score: {vol_score:.1f} x 0.3 = {vol_score*0.3:.1f}")
print(f"Semi Density Score: {semi_score:.1f} x 0.2 = {semi_score*0.2:.1f}")
print(f"Re (ERP {re_val}%) Score: {re_score:.1f} x 0.1 = {re_score*0.1:.1f}")
print(f"\n>>> NS Index = {ns_index:.1f} / 100 <<<")
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## NS Index 해석

**NS Index 58.2** = **중립-낙관 영역**

- VIX 17.48은 안정권이나, 4월 평균 19.12로 약간 상승
- 반도체 섹터의 시장 대비 초과수익이 NS Index를 끌어올리는 핵심 동력
- ERP 4.80%는 시장이 여전히 리스크를 높게 평가 중임을 시사
- **판단**: 포지션 유지 적절, 호르무즈 재폐쇄 상황 모니터링 필요
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## 호르무즈 해협 현황: 이중 봉쇄 (Double Blockade)

**통항량: 정상 대비 10% 미만 -- 30척 임계치 미달**

- **미국**: 4/13부터 이란행 선박 해상봉쇄 시행
- **이란**: 4/17 상업 선박 개방 선언 -> 4/18 재폐쇄
- **영향**: 일일 2,000만 배럴 (세계 해상 원유 20%) 통과 차단
- **한국 영향**: 헬륨(카타르 수입 65%), LNG, 나프타 수급 차질
- WTI 주중 $84~$96 극심한 변동성

**임계치 판정: 30척 미달 -- '투자 본격화 신호' 미발동**
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "호르무즈 해협 통항 추이 (개념도)"

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))

dates = ['3/1', '3/15', '3/27\n(War)', '4/7\n(Ceasefire)', '4/13\n(US block)', '4/17\n(Open)', '4/18\n(Re-close)']
ships_est = [55, 50, 35, 40, 5, 25, 5]

ax.plot(dates, ships_est, 'o-', color='#e74c3c', linewidth=2, markersize=8)
ax.axhline(y=30, color='#2ecc71', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label='30 ships threshold')
ax.fill_between(range(len(dates)), 30, [max(s, 30) for s in ships_est],
                alpha=0.1, color='green', label='Above threshold')
ax.fill_between(range(len(dates)), [min(s, 30) for s in ships_est], 30,
                alpha=0.1, color='red', label='Below threshold')

ax.set_ylabel('Estimated Daily Ships', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Hormuz Strait Ship Traffic (Estimated)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(loc='upper right')
ax.set_ylim(0, 65)

for i, (d, s) in enumerate(zip(dates, ships_est)):
    ax.annotate(f'{s}', (i, s), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0, 10),
                ha='center', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 투자자 센티멘트

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "투자자 심리 대시보드"

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4))

# Fear & Greed Gauge
gauge_val = 62
theta = np.linspace(np.pi, 0, 100)
r = 1
axes[0].plot(r*np.cos(theta), r*np.sin(theta), 'k-', linewidth=2)
for i, (start, end, color) in enumerate([
    (np.pi, np.pi*0.75, '#e74c3c'),
    (np.pi*0.75, np.pi*0.5, '#f39c12'),
    (np.pi*0.5, np.pi*0.25, '#f1c40f'),
    (np.pi*0.25, 0, '#2ecc71')
]):
    t = np.linspace(start, end, 20)
    axes[0].fill_between(0.9*np.cos(t), 0.9*np.sin(t), np.zeros_like(t),
                         alpha=0.3, color=color)

needle_angle = np.pi * (1 - gauge_val/100)
axes[0].annotate('', xy=(0.8*np.cos(needle_angle), 0.8*np.sin(needle_angle)),
                xytext=(0, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=2))
axes[0].text(0, -0.2, f'{gauge_val}', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', ha='center')
axes[0].text(0, -0.4, 'Greed', fontsize=12, ha='center', color='#2ecc71')
axes[0].set_xlim(-1.2, 1.2)
axes[0].set_ylim(-0.5, 1.2)
axes[0].set_aspect('equal')
axes[0].axis('off')
axes[0].set_title('CNN Fear & Greed', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# Retail vs Institutional
categories = ['US Retail', 'US Inst.', 'KR Retail', 'KR Foreign', 'KR Inst.']
sentiments = [4, 7.5, 3.5, 8, 7]
colors_bar = ['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71', '#e74c3c', '#2ecc71', '#2ecc71']
bars = axes[1].barh(categories, sentiments, color=colors_bar, height=0.5)
axes[1].set_xlim(0, 10)
axes[1].axvline(x=5, color='gray', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Sentiment (1=Bear, 10=Bull)')
axes[1].set_title('Retail vs Institutional', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars, sentiments):
    axes[1].text(bar.get_width() + 0.1, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                f'{val:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Key Metrics
metrics = ['VIX', 'Put/Call', 'AAII Bull', 'Crypto F&G', 'A/D Ratio']
values = [17.48, 0.45, 35.7, 23, 3.5]
signals = ['Neutral', 'Bullish', 'Bearish', 'Extreme\nFear', 'Bullish']
sig_colors = ['#f39c12', '#2ecc71', '#e74c3c', '#e74c3c', '#2ecc71']

for i, (m, v, s, c) in enumerate(zip(metrics, values, signals, sig_colors)):
    axes[2].text(0.1, 0.9-i*0.2, m, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', transform=axes[2].transAxes)
    axes[2].text(0.5, 0.9-i*0.2, f'{v}', fontsize=11, transform=axes[2].transAxes)
    axes[2].text(0.7, 0.9-i*0.2, s, fontsize=10, color=c, fontweight='bold',
                transform=axes[2].transAxes)

axes[2].axis('off')
axes[2].set_title('Key Indicators', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
